title: Lake Heiterwanger See & Lake Plansee
name: Lake Heiterwanger See & Lake Plansee
kurzbeschreibung: The Heiterwanger See near Reutte: fjord-like mountain lake at 976 m with crystal-clear water, passenger boat cruises, and a canal connecting to Plansee.
beschreibung:
Overview

The idyllic Heiterwanger See is situated in the Tyrolean Außerfern in the municipality of Heiterwang (district of Reutte) at an altitude of 976 meters above sea level. Framed by the rugged precipices of the Ammergauer Alpen and the Lechtaler Alpen, this shimmering emerald-green body of water forms Tyrol's second-largest lake system together with neighboring Plansee, to which it is linked via a 300-meter-long navigable canal. With its fjord-like scenery, pristine Class I water quality, and undeveloped shores, the Heiterwanger See ranks among western Austria's most delightful natural experiences.

Boat Cruises, Water Sports & Hiking Paradise

An unmistakable highlight of the lake is the traditional passenger boat service: for over a century, passenger vessels (such as the MS Margarethe and the MS Wilhelm) have operated scheduled services between Heiterwang and various boat landings along Plansee. Passengers glide smoothly across the mirror-like water surface and cruise through the narrow connecting canal beneath a historic wooden bridge. For active water enthusiasts, the lake offers ideal conditions: stand-up paddleboarding, rowboat and electric boat rentals, scuba diving in crystal-clear underwater depths, and refreshing swimming at natural pebble beaches draw visitors throughout the summer. Hikers appreciate the roughly six-kilometer, shaded lakeside trail that skirts the water's edge without steep gradients and offers captivating views of the striking pyramid of the Thaneller.

Visit & Getting There

The Heiterwanger See is open year-round and freely accessible free of charge; swimming access along the shores is free. Passenger boat excursions run several times daily on a fixed schedule from late May to mid-October (round trip Heiterwanger See & Plansee adults approx. €18.00, children approx. €9.00). Getting there by car: Via the Fernpassstraße B179 to Heiterwang, then follow the signage towards Heiterwanger See (large paid parking area directly beside Hotel Forelle). By public transport: Take the Außerfernbahn railway (DB/ÖBB) to Heiterwang-Plansee station, from where an easy 15-minute walk leads directly to the lakeshore.

Tips

On the lakeshore, the sun-drenched terrace of the Hotel Restaurant Forelle invites you to relax — be sure to taste the freshly caught Arctic char and trout sourced straight from the lake. The path along the southern shore is gravel-surfaced and can be comfortably navigated with all-terrain strollers.
